source: “Fits in ZXNAME0000XZ” is a capacity statement. “ZXNAME0001XZ is saturated” is a bandwidth statement. “The kernel is waiting on memory” is a latency/dependency statement. They are related but not interchangeable.
zh: “Fits in ZXNAME0000XZ”是一个容量声明。 “ZXNAME0001XZ 已饱和”是一个带宽声明。 “内核正在等待内存”是一个延迟/依赖性声明。它们是相关的但不能互换。
